scripts._build: npm run build:lib && npm run build:types && npm run build:browser
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:end-to-end
scripts.eval:decomposition: npm run eval -- --methods similo_pp,similo --modes 1,firstlast --weights default,similopp,fitted --uncompressed --name decomposition
scripts.eval:sketches: npm run eval -- --methods none --modes 1,firstlast --sketches minhash:4,minhash:2,minhash:1,simhash:1 --name sketches
scripts.eval:ablation: npm run eval -- --methods none --profiles L --ablation L --modes 1,firstlast --name ablation
scripts.eval:buckets: npm run eval -- --methods none --modes 1,firstlast --lookup buckets:1,buckets:2,buckets:3 --name buckets
scripts.eval:all: npm run eval:accuracy && npm run eval:decomposition && npm run eval:drift && npm run eval:crossval && npm run eval:sketches && npm run eval:ablation
scripts.eval:rho: PYTHONPATH=eval python eval/rho/dump_pairs.py dataset eval/results/rho-pairs.jsonl && node eval/rho/rho.mjs eval/results/rho-pairs.jsonl | tee eval/results/rho.txt
